verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB lets users turn any SQL query into a monitored rule with an operator, threshold, interval and severity, starting from templates. Each rule can be attached to reusable Slack or HTTP webhook destinations, so rules fire actions automatically when conditions are met. Missing for 10: native actions beyond notifications/webhooks (e.g., running SQL or scaling compute), true event-driven triggers rather than interval-polled thresholds, detailed docs on rule/webhook payloads, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
